title: Issue of the circular and nationwide outreach
Nodal Institutions furnish the details of their Nodal Officer and the preliminary list of institutions
Last date for the registration of institutions; wide outreach by the Nodal Institutions
Scrutiny and selection of the Participating Institutions by the Nodal Institutions, with a reserve list
Last date for the assessment of interested students by each selected Participating Institution
Consolidation and verification of the nominations by the Nodal Institutions and CICT
Academic orientation by CICT, with access to the study material and educational videos
Commencement of the one-month research and academic engagement
Research, writing and knowledge dissemination: articles/research notes and presentations at the institutions under faculty guidance
Completion of the engagement: submission of the article/research note, the activity report and the supporting records
